title: Channels
signIn: Sign in to manage owned Bot groups.
heading: One topic, several Bots
note: Owned groups only. Settings do not send messages or run Bots.
readError: Channels could not be refreshed. Reconnect; your unfinished edits are kept.
unlistedMember: Stored member not in this roster
editorNote: Rename the group or replace its full member selection. Stored unlisted members stay selected until you explicitly remove them.
name: Channel name
nameTooLong: Name is too long: {count}/{max} characters. Shorten it to save.
suspended: Editing suspended. Reconnect to verify the owner; your draft is kept.
deleteNote: Remove this channel and its stored group history. Previously delivered Bot inbox messages remain.
error.generic: Change not confirmed. Your draft is kept. Reconnect and check stored state before retrying.
error.not_found: The channel or a selected member is unavailable. Your draft is kept. Reconnect and reselect before retrying.
error.conflict: The member selection conflicts with stored state. Nothing is confirmed; check the group and retry explicitly.
error.invalid_request: The name or member selection was refused. Your draft is kept. Correct it before retrying.
error.provider_auth_failed: This account cannot manage the group. Sign in or reconnect; no change is confirmed.
